title: SoCalGuessr: Street View City Classification
description: Built and fine-tuned a pretrained ResNet-18 CNN in PyTorch for multi-class city classification from Street View images, achieving 92.27% validation accuracy and analyzing errors from class similarity and imbalance.

title: Causal Reasoning Evaluation for LLMs
description: Replicated the CausalProbe framework to evaluate knowledge retrieval versus causal inference across models, prompting strategies, and out-of-distribution benchmarks.

title: Insurance Fraud Prediction
description: Conducted an end-to-end fraud detection analysis on insurance claims data, engineered client- and company-level features, compared classification models, and interpreted key drivers of fraudulent behavior.

title: Clothing Fit Prediction
description: Built and evaluated classification models to predict clothing fit using large-scale customer and product data, including preprocessing, feature engineering, and analysis of objective measurements versus subjective reviews.

title: Recipe Preparation Time and Calorie Analysis
description: Analyzed 230K+ Food.com recipes using scikit-learn pipelines and Ridge regression to identify nutritional drivers of calories, with hyperparameter tuning, permutation testing, and fairness analysis.

title: Language Modeling Project
description: Processed and tokenized a text corpus, implemented Uniform and Unigram baselines, trained an N-gram language model, and built a sampling pipeline to generate coherent text outputs.

title: Multimedia Processing and Classification Suite
description: Developed a Python tool for image and audio processing, including grayscale conversion, edge detection, and reverb effects, and implemented a KNN model for image classification.
